seoTitle: Which Sons of Anarchy Character Are You? SAMCRO Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Sons of Anarchy test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Jax, Clay, Gemma, Tara, Opie, Chibs, Tig or Juice — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the conflicted leader trying to steer everyone somewhere better, the one quietly running things from behind the scenes, or the loyal friend who'd give everything for the people they love? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle family, loyalty and trouble, and find out which Sons of Anarchy character you are.

characters.name: Jax Teller
characters.title: The Conflicted Leader
characters.summary: Charismatic, thoughtful and torn between who you are and who you want to be. People follow you — even when you're not sure where you're going.
description: Like Jax, you're a natural leader. You were born into something bigger than you, and people look to you whether you want them to or not.
You think deeply about who you are. Jax found his father's manuscript about how the club lost its way, and it changed how he saw everything.
You want to do the right thing for your family. The trouble is, the right thing and the necessary thing aren't always the same.
characters.flaw: When people you love get hurt, you let anger make your decisions.
characters.signature: A leather cut, a hoodie underneath and a notebook he writes in at night.
characters.clashReason: they'd want to change everything you built

characters.name: Clay Morrow
characters.title: The Ruthless Old Guard
characters.summary: Powerful, calculating and determined to stay on top. You'll do whatever it takes to keep control.
description: Like Clay, you like being in charge. He was the president of SAMCRO, and he fought hard to keep the gavel in his hand.
You're pragmatic to the point of ruthlessness. You'll make the ugly decisions nobody else wants to make.
But power comes at a price, and you've made enemies — some of them very close to home.
characters.flaw: You'll betray anyone to hold on to power.
characters.signature: The president's patch, a cigar and a very long memory.
characters.clashReason: they'd do anything to keep their power

characters.name: Gemma Teller Morrow
characters.title: The Queen of Charming
characters.summary: Fierce, protective and always in control — even when it looks like you're not. You run things from behind the scenes.
description: Like Gemma, you're the real power in the room. She's the matriarch of the club, and nothing happens without her knowing about it.
You'd do anything for your family. Absolutely anything. That's both your greatest strength and the most dangerous thing about you.
You're a master of reading people and pulling strings, and you always, always protect your own.
characters.flaw: You manipulate the people you love — and you cross lines you can't come back from.
characters.signature: Big hair, sunglasses and a smile that means she's already won.

characters.name: Tara Knowles
characters.title: The Outsider Pulled In
characters.summary: Smart, principled and determined to build a better life. You tried to get out — but love pulled you back in.
description: Like Tara, you're ambitious and capable. She left Charming, became a surgeon and came back to work at the local hospital.
You've got a strong moral compass, but love makes things complicated. Tara was Jax's high school girlfriend, and the pull of that life was stronger than she expected.
You fight for your kids and for a way out — and you're tougher than people give you credit for.
characters.flaw: You stay in situations long after you know you should leave.
characters.signature: Surgical scrubs, a steady hand and a plan to get her boys out.
characters.clashReason: they'd want you out of the life

characters.name: Opie Winston
characters.title: The Loyal Brother
characters.summary: Quiet, steady and loyal beyond words. You don't talk much, but when it counts, you'd give everything for your friends.
description: Like Opie, you're the loyal one. Jax's best friend since childhood, Opie was the person everyone could count on.
You're a family person at heart. Opie tried to step back from the club for his wife and kids — but the loyalty ran too deep.
In the end, Opie sacrificed himself so his best friend could live. That's the kind of loyalty you have.
characters.flaw: You carry pain silently until it breaks you.
characters.signature: A big beard, a quiet nod and an unbreakable friendship.
characters.clashReason: they'd walk away from everything to protect their family

characters.name: Chibs Telford
characters.title: The Steady Veteran
characters.summary: Loyal, wise and steady under pressure. You've been through a lot — and you're the one people lean on.
description: Like Chibs, you've lived a lot of life. He's a Scottish-born former army medic with the scars to prove he's survived worse.
You're steady and dependable. When things fall apart, people look to you to keep them together.
You're warm and funny too, and you care deeply about the younger ones in the club.
characters.flaw: Your loyalty sometimes stops you questioning people you should.
characters.signature: A Scottish accent, a knowing smile and a medic's kit.
characters.clashReason: they'd always put the club first

characters.name: Tig Trager
characters.title: The Wild Card Enforcer
characters.summary: Intense, dark and deeply loyal. You'd follow your leader anywhere — and you've got the weirdest sense of humour in the room.
description: Like Tig, you're all in. He's the club's enforcer, and his loyalty is absolute.
You're unpredictable and a bit unhinged, with a dark sense of humour that makes people nervous.
But underneath it, you feel things deeply, and you'd go through fire for your brothers.
characters.flaw: You act on impulse, and it has terrible consequences.
characters.signature: Wild hair, intense eyes and a comment nobody else would dare make.
characters.clashReason: they'd do something unhinged and call it a joke

characters.name: Juice Ortiz
characters.title: The Anxious Tech Guy
characters.summary: Sweet, eager and desperate to belong. You're the tech brain of the group — and you worry more than anyone knows.
description: Like Juice, you're the one with the gadgets and the know-how. He handles the club's tech and intelligence work.
You want to belong more than anything. Being part of the club is Juice's whole identity.
That fear of losing everything makes you vulnerable — Juice made choices under pressure that haunted him.
characters.flaw: You panic under pressure and make choices you regret.
characters.signature: A laptop, a mohawk and a nervous laugh.

questions.text: First week at a new job. You...

options.text: Work out who has the real power and get close to them
Keep your head down and do solid work
Fix everyone's laptop so they like you
Crack a wildly inappropriate joke on day one

questions.text: You're offered a promotion that would make you your friends' boss. You...

options.text: Take it, even though you know it'll change things between you
Finally. You've wanted this for years
Say no — then accept when they insist you're the right person
Panic. What if they stop liking you?
A long ride with no destination
Poker night with the old crew
Time with family. Phone off
Something you'd rather not explain on Monday

questions.text: Someone is rude to a member of your family in public. You...

options.text: Smile sweetly. They'll regret it later
Step in immediately, fists ready
Calmly get your family out of there
Just stand there and stare until they leave

questions.text: A younger colleague is struggling. You...

options.text: Take them under your wing
Give them a real chance to prove themselves
Tell them to toughen up
Relate way too much. That was you last year

questions.text: A kid you look out for gets into a fight at school. You...

options.text: Storm into the school and sort it out yourself
Sit them down and explain why fighting isn't the answer
Pick them up and just listen on the drive home
Tell them you get it — but they can be better than that

questions.text: Someone you trusted breaks that trust. You...

options.text: Never forget it. Wait for the right moment
Lose it. Loudly, and in public
Spiral. What if it was somehow your fault?
Give them one chance to explain

questions.text: A friend asks you to lie for them. You...

options.text: No questions asked. That's what friends do
Sure — and your version will be better than theirs
Refuse. You're not lying for anyone
Agree, then panic about getting caught
Cook for everyone and run the whole thing
Bring the whisky and the good stories
Keep it small. Big parties aren't really you
Invite some very questionable people

questions.text: Your partner wants to move far away for a fresh start. You...

options.text: Think about it — but you can't leave the people who depend on you
Talk them out of it. Nobody's leaving
Go. You've wanted out for years
Panic. Everyone you belong with is here

questions.text: You're in a motorcycle club. One of the members — your friend — has been caught talking to the police, and the club wants him dealt with. You...

options.text: Warn him to pack up and leave town tonight
Hear him out first. Everyone gets a chance to explain
Do what the club decides. He knew the rules
Handle it yourself, quietly, before anyone else can

questions.text: You're in a motorcycle club. The club votes on a job that pays big money but could hurt innocent people. You...

options.text: Argue against it, then find a cleaner way to get the money
Back it. The club needs the money
Go with whatever your best friend decides
Agree — then make sure nobody innocent gets hurt
